title: Better Premionix
description: A performance-focused Vanilla+ modpack that improves FPS, adds useful QoL tweaks, and keeps the vanilla feel.
body:
Better Premionix is a performance-driven "Vanilla+" modpack designed to preserve the core feel of Minecraft while modernizing the engine and interface. It focuses on maximizing frames-per-second (FPS) and adding intuitive quality-of-life (QoL) features that feel like natural extensions of the base game.


### - Performance Enhancements
The pack uses a robust suite of optimization mods to ensure a smooth experience even on lower-end hardware:

Sodium & Sodium Extra: A complete rendering engine overhaul that significantly boosts FPS.

Lithium: Optimizes internal game systems like physics and entity AI to reduce server-side lag.

FerriteCore: Drastically reduces memory (RAM) usage by optimizing model data.

C2ME (Concurrent Chunk Management Engine): Uses multiple CPU cores to load and generate world chunks faster.

ImmediatelyFast: Speeds up the rendering of immediate-mode objects like entities and UI elements.

Dynamic FPS: Reduces resource consumption when the game is minimized or in the background.


### - Quality of Life (QoL) Mods
These mods streamline common tasks without changing the game's fundamental mechanics:

AutoSwitch: Automatically picks the best tool for the block you are mining.

Mouse Tweaks: Adds convenient inventory shortcuts, such as right-click dragging to distribute items.

Chest Search Bar: Adds a search field to all containers to quickly locate specific items.

AppleSkin: Provides detailed information about food, including hunger restoration and saturation levels.

Veinminer: Enables mining entire ore veins at once by holding a specific key.

FallingTree: Causes entire trees to drop their wood when the base block is chopped.

Double Doors: Simultaneously opens both doors in a double-door entrance.

Right Click Harvest: Allows harvesting and automatically replanting crops with a single right-click.


### - Visuals & Atmosphere
The pack enhances the aesthetic through subtle environmental and UI improvements:

Iris Shaders: High-performance shader support to add realistic lighting and shadows.

Continuity: Enables connected textures for glass and other blocks for a cleaner look.

Falling Leaves: Adds decorative falling leaf particles to tree canopies.

Visuality: Adds small particle effects, like splashes and sparkles, to environmental interactions.

Sound Physics Remastered: Implements realistic sound echoing and muffling based on your surroundings.

Chat Heads: Displays player heads next to their chat messages for better identification.


### - Utility Tools
  
Freecam: Allows you to detach the camera from your player to inspect builds or surroundings.

Zoomify: A customizable zoom mod for better long-distance visibility.

BetterF3: Replaces the standard debug screen with a much cleaner, more readable version.

Armor HUD: Displays your current armor and item durability directly on the main screen.
